title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive

entities.name: Spindlewight
entities.description: The first leader of the beasties, a six-legged, three-armed blue-green furred beast who wore a bone mask and found the first keep-alives.

entities.name: Beasties
entities.description: Shaggy, horned creatures born of cocoons in the House whose purpose is to befriend and protect keep-alives.

entities.name: Keep-alives
entities.description: The soft, furless humans whom beasties are drawn to protect and who smile at them and fear their true faces.

entities.name: The Mural
entities.description: A painting on the attic walls made by the first keep-alives that shows the beasties' history and is neutral ground.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A living house whose cocoons give rise to the beasties.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: Voraciously hungry monsters that pull themselves from walls; one attacks the first keep-alives.

entities.name: Wickerfolk
entities.description: Monsters that claim and transform victims.

events.summary: An elder beastie prepares a newly grown young beastie to learn its purpose.
events.quote: You are ready, child-no-longer, to understand your purpose here.

events.summary: The first beasties emerge from their cocoons into the House with no sense of purpose.
events.quote: When the first of us emerged from our cocoons into the splendid horror of House, we wandered with no comprehension of our purpose.

events.summary: Spindlewight, the pack's first leader, leaves to find the beasties' purpose.
events.quote: he left us, left his pack and his kin, to walk the body of House

events.summary: Spindlewight fashions a mask of bone and scrap to protect his eyes.
events.quote: To protect his eyes, he fashioned himself a mask of broken bone and stolen scrap.

events.summary: In a ruined library Spindlewight hears crying for the first time.
Spindlewight finds one adult and two small children clinging together in the wreckage.
events.quote: there he found three creatures, one large and two much smaller, clinging to each other in the wreckage.

events.summary: A cellarspawn attacks the family and Spindlewight drives it away and fells it.
events.quote: Spindlewight attacked it, driving it away from his discovery

events.summary: The adult is found pinned by a spike of wood loosened in the fight and is dying.
events.quote: a spike of jagged wood protruding from its middle

events.summary: The dying adult asks Spindlewight to keep the children alive.
Spindlewight accepts the children as keep-alives and vows to protect them.
events.quote: He would keep them alive, as long as he could.

events.summary: The first keep-alives paint the mural on the attic walls with paint Spindlewight stole for them.
events.quote: They painted it on the attic walls with their own hands

events.summary: One of the keep-alives sees Spindlewight maskless and flees, breaking his heart and ending his leadership.
events.quote: The other saw the maskless and fled into the halls, never to be seen again.

events.summary: Without Spindlewight the beasties split into the packs they have today and declare the mural neutral ground.
events.quote: we broke into the packs we occupy today

events.summary: Spindlewight's remaining keep-alive returns with his broken mask and leaves into the House.
events.quote: his keep-alive came back to the mural with his mask in hand, broken down the center

events.summary: Spindlewight dies, his bones lying somewhere in the House.
events.quote: Spindlewight's bones sleep somewhere in the House, unremarked and dearly remembered.

events.summary: The elder sends the young beastie to make a mask and find its own keep-alive.
events.quote: Fashion a mask from these things we have gathered

relations.note: Their leader at the very beginning.
relations.quote: our leader, all the way back then in the very beginning, was a great and terrible beastie who called himself Spindlewight

relations.note: Beasties describe themselves as born of the House.
relations.quote: Born we are of House, as all good things must be born of House

relations.note: He fells the cellarspawn that attacked the keep-alives.
relations.quote: it was felled by his power and his persistence
a beastie is at their very best when they have a keep-alive to protect and care for
Those first two, they gave us the mural.
